name: Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park
tagline: Hawaiʻi Volcanoes — crater rim and steam vents; conditions change with activity.

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; check eruption/closure alerts before you go.
practical.transit_note: From Hilo side; Chain of Craters may be long.
practical.energy_note: Sulfur air can bother lungs; stay on marked paths.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → rim walk or steam vents → museum
practical.season_note: Access changes with volcanic activity — verify NPS alerts.
